title: actions/checkout fails in container-based jobs on act_runner because Node.js is expected inside the job container
body:
I'm currently a GitHub Actions user and I'm evaluating a migration to Gitea. While comparing the two runners, I found a behavioral difference around how actions/checkout (and JavaScript Actions in general) is executed when a job specifies a container:.

On GitHub Actions, a JavaScript Action like actions/checkout runs on the runner host, using the Node.js runtime bundled with the runner. It does not need Node.js to be present inside the job container. This means a workflow like the following works fine on GitHub, even though the skopeo image contains no Node.js:
```
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    container:
      image: quay.io/containers/skopeo:latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: skopeo --version
```
On Gitea with act_runner, the same workflow fails, reporting that node is missing. This appears to be because act_runner executes JavaScript Actions inside the job container, so the container image must itself provide Node.js.

Expected behavior
It would be ideal if act_runner could handle JavaScript Actions the way GitHub's runner does — by providing a Node.js runtime on the host side (or injecting one into the job container) so that actions/checkout and other JS Actions work regardless of whether the job container ships with Node.js.

Actual behavior
act_runner tries to invoke node inside the job container. If the container image (e.g. quay.io/containers/skopeo:latest) does not include Node.js, the step fails.

Why this matters for migration
This is a notable migration friction point: many users run jobs in minimal, purpose-built container images (tool images like skopeo, kaniko, aws-cli, etc.) that intentionally contain only the tool they need. On GitHub these workflows work because the runner supplies Node for JS Actions. 


I notice that this issue has been reopened. When working with various external images or workflows, there is often no guarantee that `apt install nodejs` will be supported, which can lead to significant time spent modifying `workflow.yml` files. In such cases, invoking the Node.js instance directly from the host machine might be a better approach.
https://gitea.com/orbit/orbit/issues/538

title: tool cache for concurrent tasks
body:
Hi,
according to [config.yml](https://gitea.com/orbit/orbit/src/branch/main/internal/pkg/config/config.example.yaml#L131) it's not recommended to enable the shared tool cache (`runner.tool_cache_mode=shared`) with `runner.capacity!=1` .

Thinking out loud - would it be an easy option to append the runner instance to the `act-toolcache` volume - https://gitea.com/orbit/orbit/src/commit/95ef17d02261efcc69054b259c745cec8a33b600/act/runner/run_context.go#L263 to avoid the conflicts?
Of course this would increase the diskspace but might be a simple solution for `capacity: <2|3>`.

title: Docker CA for dind images
body:
Hi,
I noticed #1366 which is most probably a great help (didn't test it yet).
I want to highlight that when a selfhosted dockerproxy/dockerregistry is used docker also needs a proper CA chain set up.

I want to suggest two things - not only related to the orbit runner images but also the orbit images itself.
The linuxserver.io images define a `/custom-cont-init.d` folder / the nginx images define a similar `/entrypoint.d` folder that is used to run some scripts BEFORE the real work starts. This way it would be possible to mount some scripts that do container internal bootstrapping like e.g. a certificate chain update of the dind image.
For dind-rootless this would course require that the image starts as `root` and uses e.g. `suexec` to switch to the intended rootless user.

Second idea - root-ca related.
For the root-ca update I could also image that the custom root-ca is passed (via environment) as a URL alongside with a CHECKSUM making it bind-mount-less (the checksum could solve the certificate chain chicken-and-egg problem).

I created a own docker image a while ago - https://github.com/maya2/act_runner-docuum-dind#custom-cont-initd that includes the  `/custom-cont-init.d` already.

title: The deployment process for Gitea Runner is quite complex.
body:
The current deployment method for Gitea Runner is quite complex.
Could we follow GitHub’s design by using a single, unified installation package that can simply be extracted and then configured?

![image.png](attachments/de00215d-1c74-4843-92bd-47b326128f16)


Currently, I’m using a script to achieve something similar.
```
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Standalone bootstrap: copy only this file into the intended runner directory.
set -Eeuo pipefail

main() {
    if [[ ${1:-} == --help || ${1:-} == -h ]]; then
        echo '用法：bash gitea-runner-install.sh'
        echo '在脚本所在目录生成管理脚本并安装 Runner；Node.js 24 由用户自行提供。'
        return
    fi
    if [[ $# != 0 ]]; then echo '错误：不支持的参数。' >&2; return 1; fi
    local RUNNER_DIR VERSION arch tmp file url helper
    RUNNER_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd -P)
    cd "$RUNNER_DIR"
    fail() { echo "错误：$*" >&2; exit 1; }
    [[ $EUID != 0 ]] || fail '请以运行 Runner 的普通用户执行；只有服务管理使用 sudo。'
    [[ $(uname -s) == Linux ]] || fail '此安装脚本目前支持 Linux。'
    VERSION=${GITEA_RUNNER_VERSION:-5.3.0}
    [[ $VERSION =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]] || fail '版本号格式无效。'
    for command in curl sha256sum python3 git flock; do command -v "$command" >/dev/null || fail "缺少依赖：$command"; done
    [[ ! -e .runner && ! -e .service ]] || fail '此目录已有注册或服务，请使用现有管理脚本。'
    case $(uname -m) in x86_64) arch=amd64 ;; aarch64|arm64) arch=arm64 ;; *) fail '不支持的系统架构。' ;; esac
    tmp=$(mktemp -d)
    trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
    file="gitea-runner-${VERSION}-linux-${arch}"
    url="https://dl.gitea.com/gitea-runner/${VERSION}/${file}"
    echo "下载并校验 Gitea Runner $VERSION ($arch)..."
    curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 300 --retry 3 "$url" -o "$tmp/$file"
    curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 300 --retry 3 "$url.sha256" -o "$tmp/$file.sha256"
    (cd "$tmp" && sha256sum -c "$file.sha256")

    # Materialize the embedded management scripts; no separate package is needed.
    write_helpers "$tmp/helpers"
    for helper in runner-common.sh config.sh run.sh runsvc.sh svc svc.sh; do
        install -m 755 "$tmp/helpers/$helper" "$RUNNER_DIR/$helper"
    done
    install -m 644 "$tmp/helpers/runner-manage.py" "$RUNNER_DIR/runner-manage.py"
    install -D -m 644 "$tmp/helpers/examples/smoke.yaml" "$RUNNER_DIR/examples/smoke.yaml"
    install -m 755 "$tmp/$file" "$RUNNER_DIR/gitea-runner"
    source "$RUNNER_DIR/runner-common.sh"
    [[ -f $RUNNER_CONFIG ]] || "$RUNNER_BIN" config init -c "$RUNNER_CONFIG"
    set_local_paths
    echo "安装目录：$RUNNER_DIR"
    echo '注册：./config.sh --url https://gitea.example.com --token YOUR_REGISTRATION_TOKEN'
    echo '安装服务：sudo ./svc install'
    echo 'Node.js 24 请自行编译提供；运行时会将 externals/node24/bin 和 externals/node24 加入 PATH。'
    echo '启动服务：sudo ./svc start'
    echo '查看状态：sudo ./svc status'
    echo '提示：容器任务、Docker actions 和 services 仍需要 Docker。'
    # The EXIT trap runs after main returns, so clean up while tmp is in scope.
    rm -rf "$tmp"
    trap - EXIT
}

# Embedded scripts are checked against their editable source files by test_standalone.py.
write_helpers() {
    local destination=$1
    mkdir -p "$destination/examples"
    cat > "$destination/runner-common.sh" <<'GITEA_EMBED_RUNNER_COMMON_SH'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Shared by the directory-local management scripts.
RUNNER_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd -P)
RUNNER_BIN="$RUNNER_DIR/gitea-runner"
RUNNER_CONFIG="$RUNNER_DIR/config.yaml"
fail() { echo "错误：$*" >&2; exit 1; }
need_binary() { [[ -x $RUNNER_BIN ]] || fail '请先运行 bash gitea-runner-install.sh 下载 Runner。'; }
need_registration() { [[ -f $RUNNER_DIR/.runner ]] || fail '尚未注册，请先运行 ./config.sh。'; }
need_user() { [[ $EUID != 0 ]] || fail '请以运行 Runner 的普通用户执行；只有 svc 使用 sudo。'; }
service_name() {
    [[ -f $RUNNER_DIR/.service ]] || return 1
    local name
    name=$(cat "$RUNNER_DIR/.service")
    [[ $name =~ ^orbit\.runner\.[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+\.service$ ]] || fail '.service 内容无效。'
    printf '%s\n' "$name"
}
normalize_labels() {
    local raw=$1 item
    [[ $raw != *$'\n'* && $raw != *$'\r'* ]] || fail '标签不能包含换行。'
    [[ -n $raw && $raw != ,* && $raw != *, && $raw != *,,* ]] || fail '标签不能为空。'
    local -a parts
    IFS=, read -r -a parts <<< "$raw"
    for item in "${parts[@]}"; do
        item="${item#"${item%%[![:space:]]*}"}"; item="${item%"${item##*[![:space:]]}"}"
        [[ -n $item && $item != *[[:space:]]* ]] || fail '标签不能为空或包含空白字符。'
        [[ $item == *:* ]] || item="$item:host"
        [[ -n ${item%%:*} ]] || fail '标签名称不能为空。'
        [[ $item == *:host || $item == *:docker://?* ]] || fail "标签格式无效：$item；请使用 name、name:host 或 name:docker://image。"
        printf '%s\n' "$item"
    done
}
set_local_paths() {
    "$RUNNER_BIN" config set -c "$RUNNER_CONFIG" runner.file "$RUNNER_DIR/.runner" >/dev/null
    "$RUNNER_BIN" config set -c "$RUNNER_CONFIG" host.workdir_parent "$RUNNER_DIR/_work" >/dev/null
    "$RUNNER_BIN" config set -c "$RUNNER_CONFIG" cache.dir "$RUNNER_DIR/_cache" >/dev/null
    "$RUNNER_BIN" config set -c "$RUNNER_CONFIG" log.job.dir "$RUNNER_DIR/_diag" >/dev/null
    "$RUNNER_BIN" config set -c "$RUNNER_CONFIG" runner.shutdown_timeout 4m30s >/dev/null
    mkdir -p "$RUNNER_DIR/_work" "$RUNNER_DIR/_cache" "$RUNNER_DIR/_diag" "$RUNNER_DIR/.cache"
    chmod 600 "$RUNNER_CONFIG"
}

lock_runner() {
    exec 9>"$RUNNER_DIR/.runner-management.lock"
    flock -n 9 || fail 'Runner 正在运行或另一个管理操作正在执行，请先停止 Runner。'
}
GITEA_EMBED_RUNNER_COMMON_SH
    cat > "$destination/config.sh" <<'GITEA_EMBED_CONFIG_SH'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -Eeuo pipefail
source "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/runner-common.sh"
usage() {
    cat <<'HELP'
注册： ./config.sh [--url URL] [--token TOKEN | --token-file FILE] [--name NAME] [--labels LABELS] [--unattended]
标签： ./config.sh labels --add ubuntu-24.04
       ./config.sh labels --remove ubuntu-24.04
       ./config.sh labels --labels self-hosted,linux,AMD64,large
       ./config.sh labels                  # 查看完整标签
解绑： ./config.sh remove --scope admin --token-file /path/to/api-token
       ./config.sh remove --server-removed # 已在 Gitea 网页删除后清理本地身份
scope：admin、user、org:组织名、repo:所有者/仓库名。
注册 Token 与删除 Runner 所需的用户 API Token 用途不同。
简单标签默认使用 :host；显式 name:docker://image 可使用容器。
HELP
}
[[ ${1:-} != --help && ${1:-} != -h ]] || { usage; exit; }
need_user
need_binary
command=${1:-register}
case $command in remove|labels|register) [[ $# == 0 ]] || shift ;; *) command=register ;; esac
cd "$RUNNER_DIR"
case $command in
register)
    lock_runner
    [[ ! -f .runner ]] || fail '已注册；调整标签请使用 ./config.sh labels，解绑请使用 ./config.sh remove。'
    [[ ! -f .service ]] || fail '服务仍已安装，请先 sudo ./svc uninstall。'
    case $(uname -m) in x86_64) default_arch=X64 ;; aarch64|arm64) default_arch=ARM64 ;; *) default_arch=$(uname -m) ;; esac
    default_labels="self-hosted,linux,$default_arch"
    url=${GITEA_INSTANCE_URL:-}; name=${GITEA_RUNNER_NAME:-}; raw=${GITEA_RUNNER_LABELS:-}; token_file=''; token_arg_set=false; unattended=false
    while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
        case $1 in
            --url|--token|--name|--labels|--token-file) [[ $# -ge 2 && -n $2 && $2 != --* ]] || fail "$1 需要一个值。"; case $1 in --url) url=$2 ;; --token) GITEA_RUNNER_REGISTRATION_TOKEN=$2; token_arg_set=true ;; --name) name=$2 ;; --labels) raw=$2 ;; --token-file) token_file=$2 ;; esac; shift 2 ;;
            --unattended) unattended=true; shift ;;
            *) fail "未知参数：$1" ;;
        esac
    done
    if $token_arg_set && [[ -n $token_file ]]; then fail '--token 和 --token-file 只能使用一种。'; fi
    if [[ -n $token_file ]]; then GITEA_RUNNER_REGISTRATION_TOKEN=$(cat -- "$token_file"); fi
    if ! $unattended; then
        [[ -n $url ]] || read -r -p 'Gitea 地址: ' url
        if [[ -z ${GITEA_RUNNER_REGISTRATION_TOKEN:-} ]]; then read -r -s -p 'Runner 注册 Token: ' GITEA_RUNNER_REGISTRATION_TOKEN; echo; fi
        [[ -n $name ]] || { read -r -p "Runner 名称 [$(hostname)]: " name; name=${name:-$(hostname)}; }
        [[ -n $raw ]] || { read -r -p "标签 [$default_labels]: " raw; }
    fi
    [[ $url =~ ^https?://[^[:space:]]+$ ]] || fail '请输入有效的 Gitea HTTP/HTTPS 地址。'
    [[ -n ${GITEA_RUNNER_REGISTRATION_TOKEN:-} ]] || fail '缺少 Runner 注册 Token。'
    name=${name:-$(hostname)}; raw=${raw:-$default_labels}
    normalized=$(normalize_labels "$raw")
    mapfile -t labels <<< "$normalized"
    umask 077
    [[ -f $RUNNER_CONFIG ]] || "$RUNNER_BIN" config init -c "$RUNNER_CONFIG"
    set_local_paths
    "$RUNNER_BIN" config set -c "$RUNNER_CONFIG" runner.labels "${labels[@]}" >/dev/null
    joined=$(IFS=,; echo "${labels[*]}")
    export GITEA_RUNNER_REGISTRATION_TOKEN
    "$RUNNER_BIN" register -c "$RUNNER_CONFIG" --no-interactive --instance "$url" --name "$name" --labels "$joined"
    unset GITEA_RUNNER_REGISTRATION_TOKEN
    chmod 600 .runner
    echo '注册完成。前台启动：./run.sh；安装服务：sudo ./svc install && sudo ./svc start'
    ;;
labels)
    need_registration
    current=$("$RUNNER_BIN" config get -c "$RUNNER_CONFIG" runner.labels 2>/dev/null) || current=
    [[ -n $current ]] || current=$(python3 "$RUNNER_DIR/runner-manage.py" labels)
    labels=(); [[ -z $current ]] || mapfile -t labels <<< "$current"
    [[ $# -gt 0 ]] || { printf '%s\n' "${labels[@]}"; exit; }
    [[ $# == 2 ]] || fail '用法：./config.sh labels --add LABELS | --remove LABELS | --labels LABELS'
    case $1 in
        --labels) normalized=$(normalize_labels "$2"); mapfile -t labels <<< "$normalized" ;;
        --add)
            normalized=$(normalize_labels "$2"); mapfile -t additions <<< "$normalized"
            for addition in "${additions[@]}"; do
                next=(); for label in "${labels[@]}"; do [[ ${label%%:*} == "${addition%%:*}" ]] || next+=("$label"); done
                labels=("${next[@]}" "$addition")
            done
            ;;
        --remove)
            IFS=, read -r -a removals <<< "$2"
            next=()
            for label in "${labels[@]}"; do
                keep=true; for removal in "${removals[@]}"; do [[ ${label%%:*} != "${removal%%:*}" ]] || keep=false; done
                $keep && next+=("$label")
            done
            labels=("${next[@]}")
            ;;
        *) fail "未知参数：$1" ;;
    esac
    [[ ${#labels[@]} -gt 0 ]] || fail '必须至少保留一个标签。'
    "$RUNNER_BIN" config set -c "$RUNNER_CONFIG" runner.labels "${labels[@]}"
    chmod 600 "$RUNNER_CONFIG"
    echo '标签已保存，重启后向 Gitea 更新：sudo ./svc restart（前台运行时重启 run.sh）。'
    ;;
remove)
    lock_runner
    need_registration
    [[ ! -f .service ]] || fail '请先 sudo ./svc stop，再 sudo ./svc uninstall。'
    if [[ $# == 1 && $1 == --server-removed ]]; then
        echo '按您的声明，Gitea 服务端记录已删除；清理本地注册身份。'
    else
        python3 "$RUNNER_DIR/runner-manage.py" remove "$@"
    fi
    rm -- .runner
    echo '本地注册身份已清理。配置、程序和工作文件保留；可重新运行 ./config.sh 注册。'
    ;;
esac
GITEA_EMBED_CONFIG_SH
    cat > "$destination/run.sh" <<'GITEA_EMBED_RUN_SH'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -Eeuo pipefail
source "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/runner-common.sh"
need_user
need_binary
need_registration
if name=$(service_name) && systemctl is-active --quiet "$name"; then
    fail '服务正在运行，请先 sudo ./svc stop。'
fi
lock_runner
cd "$RUNNER_DIR"
export XDG_CACHE_HOME="$RUNNER_DIR/.cache"
export PATH="$RUNNER_DIR/externals/node24/bin:$RUNNER_DIR/externals/node24:$PATH"
exec "$RUNNER_BIN" daemon --config "$RUNNER_CONFIG" "$@"
GITEA_EMBED_RUN_SH
    cat > "$destination/runsvc.sh" <<'GITEA_EMBED_RUNSVC_SH'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -Eeuo pipefail
source "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/runner-common.sh"
need_user
need_binary
need_registration
lock_runner
cd "$RUNNER_DIR"
export XDG_CACHE_HOME="$RUNNER_DIR/.cache"
export PATH="$RUNNER_DIR/externals/node24/bin:$RUNNER_DIR/externals/node24:$PATH"
exec "$RUNNER_BIN" daemon --config "$RUNNER_CONFIG"
GITEA_EMBED_RUNSVC_SH
    cat > "$destination/svc" <<'GITEA_EMBED_SVC'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -Eeuo pipefail
source "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/runner-common.sh"
if [[ $# == 0 || ${1:-} == --help || ${1:-} == -h ]]; then
    echo '用法：sudo ./svc {install [USER]|start|stop|restart|status|uninstall}'
    exit
fi
[[ $EUID == 0 ]] || fail '服务管理请使用 sudo ./svc。'
command=$1; shift
case $command in
install)
    [[ $# -le 1 ]] || fail '用法：sudo ./svc install [USER]'
    need_binary; need_registration
    [[ ! -f $RUNNER_DIR/.service ]] || fail '此目录已安装服务。'
    user=${1:-${SUDO_USER:-}}
    [[ -n $user && $user != root ]] || fail '请指定运行服务的普通用户，例如 sudo ./svc install vesoft。'
    id "$user" >/dev/null || fail "用户不存在：$user"
    [[ $(stat -c %u "$RUNNER_DIR") == "$(id -u "$user")" ]] || fail '安装目录必须属于服务运行用户。'
    [[ $RUNNER_DIR =~ ^/[A-Za-z0-9/_.-]+$ ]] || fail 'systemd 安装目录暂不支持空格、非 ASCII 或特殊符号。'
    name=$(python3 "$RUNNER_DIR/runner-manage.py" service-name)
    unit="/etc/systemd/system/$name"
    [[ ! -e $unit ]] || fail "同名服务已存在：$unit"
    runuser -u "$user" -- test -r "$RUNNER_DIR/.runner" || fail '运行用户无法读取注册文件。'
    cat > "$unit" <<UNIT
[Unit]
Description=Gitea Actions Runner ($name)
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=$RUNNER_DIR/runsvc.sh
User=$user
WorkingDirectory=$RUNNER_DIR
KillMode=control-group
KillSignal=SIGTERM
TimeoutStopSec=5min
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5s

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
UNIT
    printf '%s\n' "$name" > "$RUNNER_DIR/.service"
    chown "$user:$(id -gn "$user")" "$RUNNER_DIR/.service"
    chmod 600 "$RUNNER_DIR/.service"
    systemctl daemon-reload
    systemctl enable "$name"
    echo "服务已安装：$unit；启动请运行 sudo ./svc start"
    ;;
start|stop|restart|status|uninstall)
    [[ $# == 0 ]] || fail '不支持额外参数。'
    name=$(service_name) || fail '此目录尚未安装服务。'
    echo "/etc/systemd/system/$name"
    if [[ $command == uninstall ]]; then
        state=$(systemctl show "$name" -p ActiveState --value)
        [[ $state == inactive || $state == failed ]] || fail '请先 sudo ./svc stop。'
        systemctl disable "$name"
        rm -- "/etc/systemd/system/$name"
        systemctl daemon-reload
        systemctl reset-failed "$name" 2>/dev/null || true
        rm -- "$RUNNER_DIR/.service"
        echo '服务已卸载，Runner 注册身份保留。解绑请运行 ./config.sh remove。'
    elif [[ $command == status ]]; then
        systemctl status "$name" --no-pager --full
    else
        systemctl "$command" "$name"
    fi
    ;;
*) fail "未知操作：$command" ;;
esac
GITEA_EMBED_SVC
    cat > "$destination/svc.sh" <<'GITEA_EMBED_SVC_SH'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Compatibility entry point for installations that used svc.sh.
set -Eeuo pipefail
exec "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/svc" "$@"
GITEA_EMBED_SVC_SH
    cat > "$destination/runner-manage.py" <<'GITEA_EMBED_RUNNER_MANAGE_PY'
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Directory-local runner metadata and server-side removal; never print tokens."""
import argparse
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import sys
from urllib import error, parse, request

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent


def main():
    data = json.loads((ROOT / '.runner').read_text())
    operation = sys.argv[1]
    if operation == 'labels':
        print('\n'.join(data.get('labels', [])))
        return
    if operation == 'service-name':
        def slug(value):
            return re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]+', '-', value).strip('-.') or 'runner'
        host = parse.urlsplit(data['address']).netloc
        print(f"gitea.runner.{slug(host)}.{slug(data['name'])}.service")
        return
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description='Delete the runner from Gitea before removing local credentials.')
    parser.add_argument('--scope', required=True, help='admin, user, org:NAME, repo:OWNER/REPO')
    parser.add_argument('--token-file', help='Personal API access token file (not a registration token)')
    args = parser.parse_args(sys.argv[2:])
    token = Path(args.token_file).read_text().strip() if args.token_file else os.environ.get('GITEA_API_TOKEN', '').strip()
    if not token:
        raise ValueError('删除需要用户 API Token：--token-file FILE 或 GITEA_API_TOKEN；注册 Token 无法删除 Runner。')
    if args.scope in ('admin', 'user'):
        prefix = args.scope
    elif args.scope.startswith('org:') and args.scope[4:] and '/' not in args.scope[4:]:
        prefix = 'orgs/' + parse.quote(args.scope[4:], safe='')
    elif args.scope.startswith('repo:') and len(args.scope[5:].split('/')) == 2 and all(args.scope[5:].split('/')):
        prefix = 'repos/' + '/'.join(parse.quote(part, safe='') for part in args.scope[5:].split('/'))
    else:
        raise ValueError('scope 必须为 admin、user、org:组织名或 repo:所有者/仓库名。')
    runner_id = int(data['id'])
    if runner_id <= 0:
        raise ValueError('本地 Runner ID 无效。')
    address = data['address'].rstrip('/')
    parsed = parse.urlsplit(address)
    if parsed.scheme not in ('http', 'https') or not parsed.netloc or parsed.query or parsed.fragment or parsed.username:
        raise ValueError('注册记录中的 Gitea 地址无效。')
    url = f'{address}/api/v1/{prefix}/actions/runners/{runner_id}'

    class NoRedirect(request.HTTPRedirectHandler):
        def redirect_request(self, req, fp, code, msg, headers, newurl):
            return None

    req = request.Request(url, method='DELETE', headers={'Authorization': f'token {token}', 'Accept': 'application/json'})
    try:
        with request.build_opener(NoRedirect).open(req, timeout=30) as response:
            if response.status != 204:
                raise ValueError(f'删除接口返回 HTTP {response.status}，保留本地身份。')
    except error.HTTPError as exc:
        raise ValueError(f'Gitea 删除失败（HTTP {exc.code}）；检查 API Token 权限、scope 和 Gitea API 可达性。本地身份保留。') from None
    print(f'已从 Gitea 删除 Runner {runner_id} ({data["name"]})。')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    try:
        main()
    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, error.URLError) as exc:
        sys.exit(f'错误：{exc}')
GITEA_EMBED_RUNNER_MANAGE_PY
    cat > "$destination/examples/smoke.yaml" <<'GITEA_EMBED_EXAMPLES_SMOKE_YAML'
name: runner-execution-smoke
on: [workflow_dispatch]
jobs:
  host:
    runs-on: [self-hosted, linux, X64]
    steps:
      - name: Verify host execution
        run: |
          test ! -f /.dockerenv
          id
          hostname
          cat /etc/os-release
          echo "HOST_EXECUTION_OK"
  container:
    runs-on: [self-hosted, linux, X64]
    container:
      image: alpine:3.21
    steps:
      - name: Verify explicit job container
        run: |
          test -f /.dockerenv
          test -f /etc/alpine-release
          cat /etc/alpine-release
          echo "CONTAINER_EXECUTION_OK"
GITEA_EMBED_EXAMPLES_SMOKE_YAML
}

main "$@"

```

title: Using a random value for the Gitea Runner task working directory is not ideal.
body: When a Gitea runner executes a job, it uses a randomized directory structure—for example, `_work/random/random`. In contrast, GitHub Actions uses a predictable structure: `_work/repo/repo`. This difference makes it much easier to locate the relevant directory and address any permission issues that may arise during CI/CD processes.

title: Container hooks: delegate container lifecycle to an external entrypoint (K8s and other backends)
body:
# Container hooks: delegate container lifecycle to an external entrypoint (K8s and other backends)

## Summary

Add a "container hooks" mode to the runner. When enabled, the runner stops
calling the Docker API altogether and delegates every container lifecycle
operation to an external entrypoint that the operator supplies. The runner
invokes this entrypoint once per hook event — `prepare`, `execute`,
`cleanup` — and exchanges structured data with it through a per-job state
directory and environment variables.

This makes the runner backend-agnostic: the same runner binary can drive
Docker out-of-process, Kubernetes pods, Nomad jobs, or nothing at all in
tests. The runner no longer assumes the job runs in a container it
manages.

## Motivation

Today the runner assumes it owns the container the job runs in: it creates
it, starts it, execs into it, copies files into and out of it, and removes
it. Every one of those operations goes through the Docker API.

That assumption blocks several use cases:

- Running jobs on Kubernetes without a Docker daemon anywhere on the
  runner host.
- Running jobs inside a single pod that also hosts the runner, where the
  job containers are managed by an orchestrator rather than the runner.
- Future container-backends that are not Docker-shaped at all.

The upstream GitHub Actions runner solves this with container hooks: a
directory of scripts the runner invokes instead of calling the Docker API.
This proposal adopts that idea.

## Proposal

### Configuration

```yaml
container:
  hooks:
    enabled: true
    # Optional interpreter used to launch cmd (e.g. /bin/sh, cmd.exe).
    entrypoint: /bin/sh
    # Required when enabled=true.
    cmd: /opt/container-hooks/main.sh
```

When `container.hooks.enabled` is true, the runner:

- refuses to call the Docker API for any job container operation;
- invokes `entrypoint cmd` once per hook event;
- passes the event name in `RUNNER_CONTAINER_HOOK_TYPE`;
- exchanges JSON files with the hook through a per-job state directory.

### Lifecycle

```text
prepare -> execute (step 1) -> execute (step 2) -> ... -> execute (step N) -> cleanup
```

- `prepare` runs once, before all steps.
- `execute` runs once per step, with one of three kinds: `script` (a `run:`
  step), `command` (a JS or Go action), `container-step` (a
  `uses: docker://...` step).
- `cleanup` runs once, after every step including post steps of actions.

### Contract

Full contract is in the accompanying doc (`docs/container-hooks.md`).
In short:

- Per-job state directory at `RUNNER_CONTAINER_HOOK_STATE_DIR`, containing
  `<event>-input.json` (runner → hook) and `<event>.json` (hook → runner).
- Runner-owned env vars under `RUNNER_CONTAINER_HOOK_*`.
- Passthrough of `GITHUB_*` / `RUNNER_*` / workflow `env:` into the hook
  environment.
- Credentials travel as `{"$env": "VAR_NAME"}` references in JSON, with
  the real value in the hook's process environment under
  `RUNNER_CONTAINER_HOOK_SECRET_*`.
- `prepare.json` returns `id` (required), `actPath` (optional — where the
  hook will stage workflow files and actions), and `environments`
  (optional hook-to-hook variables).
- `execute.json` returns `exitCode` and the contents of the file-command
  files (`GITHUB_OUTPUT`, `GITHUB_STATE`, `GITHUB_ENV`, `GITHUB_PATH`,
  `GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY`).

### Action handling

The runner downloads external actions into its own cache as it does today,
but in hook mode it does not copy them into a job container. Instead it
passes the list of downloaded actions (`hash`, `localPath`) to the prepare
hook, and rewrites action command paths to `<actPath>/actions/<hash>/` so
the hook knows where to stage them and node/exec inside the job finds them
where the hook put them.

### Compatibility

- The mode is off by default. When disabled, the runner behaves exactly as
  today and calls the Docker API as before.
- `Config.ActionCache` (git-object-store backend) is refused in hook mode:
  the hook cannot reach the object store.
- Job hooks (`JobStartedHook` / `JobCompletedHook`) are not yet integrated
  and are skipped in hook mode. This is documented as a known limitation.

## Planned changes

The change will:
- Adds the `container.hooks` config block.
- Wires the hook invocation into `startJobContainer`, `runStepExecutor`,
  `execJobContainer`, and `cleanupJobResources`.
- Adds a new package `act/container/hooks` with the protocol types and the
  entrypoint invoker.
- Adds an end-to-end test under `act/runner/testdata/container-hooks/`
  exercising `run:`, `uses: docker://...`, and a JS action, all with no
  Docker API calls.
- Adds the doc describing the contract.

Out of scope (follow-ups):

- Integrating `JobStartedHook` / `JobCompletedHook` with hook mode.
- Streaming hook output live to the UI (currently buffered).
- Per-hook timeouts.

## Testing

```bash
go test ./act/runner/ -run TestContainerHooksRun -v
```

## Example hooks

A minimal reference implementation of the hook entrypoint lives in the
repo under `act/runner/testdata/container-hooks/hooks/`. It is deliberately
simplified: it does not talk to any orchestrator, it just stages files into
a directory under the state dir and runs the step command locally. That is
enough to demonstrate the contract and to serve as a starting point for
real implementations.

Prototypes of Kubernetes hooks are planned in the near future. They will
show how the same contract drives a real backend: create a pod in
`prepare`, exec into it from `execute`, tear it down in `cleanup`. When
they are ready, they will land in the same testdata tree as an additional
reference, alongside the plain one.

## Status and call for feedback

This feature is under active development. The contract above is the
current shape of it, and it is stable enough to be useful, but the
details may still change while the implementation settles and real-world
hooks get written against it.

I would very much welcome discussion and support from the community:

- If you have a use case that does not fit the current contract, please
  describe it here. The goal is a general mechanism, not a
  Kubernetes-only one, so real constraints from other backends are the
  most valuable input.
- If you already run a self-hosted setup with a custom container
  lifecycle (Kubernetes, Nomad, remote Docker hosts, anything else),
  I would like to hear how you would want the hook to look from your
  side.
- If you are willing to help with implementation, testing on your
  environment, or reviewing the contract, please say so in the thread.

Reviews, corrections, and edge cases are all welcome. I will keep the
issue updated as the implementation progresses.

title: Feature Request: Add debugging capability (DAP Integration) to orbit runner
body:
### What problem would this solve?

Currently, debugging Gitea Actions workflows primarily relies on print-based debugging (logging). This process is slow and tedious. Developers have to repeatedly modify workflows, commit, push, and wait for logs just to inspect internal states or fix trivial bugs.

### What do you propose?

Inspired by [actions/runner#4298](https://github.com/actions/runner/pull/4298) I propose integrating the **Debug Adapter Protocol (DAP)** into `act_runner`. This would allow developers to attach their favorite IDEs/editors (such as VS Code) directly to a running job, drastically shortening the feedback loop when developing and iterating on Gitea Actions workflows. 

#### Proposed Capabilities

This integration would enable:

1. **Step-by-step execution**: Pause execution before any `run` or `uses` step.
2. **Environment Inspection**: View real-time environment variables and secrets (properly masked).
3. **REPL / Debug Console**: Execute ad-hoc shell commands within the job container during a breakpoint pause.
4. **Filesystem Browsing**: Explore the container's filesystem directly from the debugger's variable/workspace view.

### Current Progress & Implementation Details

I have investigated the codebase and already developed a working prototype in a local branch. Since the Gitea runner is written in Go, implementing this feature directly within the runner codebase proved to be straightforward.

The current prototype uses the following architecture:

* **Core Protocol**: A Go implementation of the DAP server utilizing [github.com/google/go-dap](https://github.com/google/go-dap).
* **Execution Hooks**: Minimal changes to `act/runner/step.go` to inject a `handleDapPause` hook.
* **State Provider**: An interface allowing the DAP server to query `RunContext` for environment variables, step results, and file contents.

### Proposed Architecture & Flow

1. **Runner Side**: `act_runner` spins up a DAP TCP server (opt-in via the environment variable `ACTIONS_RUNNER_DEBUG_DAP=true`).
2. **Gitea Side (Future Extensibility)**: Potentially implement a WebSocket proxy within Gitea to bridge the connection between the developer's local VS Code instance and the remote Runner. This would seamlessly solve NAT/firewall traversal issues for self-hosted runners.
